comment.en: The disruption risk at Penghu over the next 5 days is Medium, mainly due to strong winds. From 11/10 08:00 to 20:00, the airport forecast (TAF) shows gusts of 40 kt, reaching the Medium threshold of 37 kt; during 08:00–14:00, seven of seven models say Medium or above, with the European model showing gusts of 45.5 kt.
